description: Price a complex good in CBAM certificates in three independent runs plus a session receipt: roll up precursor emissions for a declared final good and quantity (ART-72), calculate consignment embedded emissions from declared direct data and a declared precursor total (ART-69), then model the certificate liability, holding schedule and surrender deadline from the declared embedded total (ART-71), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run execution hashes (CRY-05). Each run computes from its own declared inputs. This chain is decision support, not a filed CBAM declaration, not a verification, and not a surrender of certificates.
name: cbam-precursor-certificate-liability-check
regulatory_refs: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2621 (default values, applying 1 January 2026)

steps.handoff: Rolls up embedded emissions across declared precursors for a declared final good and quantity, with a per-precursor breakdown, a mass-fraction total, and a data quality grade. The 2028 pre-consumer-scrap rule is applied only when a scrap input share is declared, and its credit modelling is a preliminary approximation to verify against final text.

Calculates consignment embedded emissions from declared direct and indirect data, a declared good category, country of origin and quantity, plus a declared precursor total cited from the step 1 run. The run states its emissions basis as actual or default in its own record, and its indirect component uses the kernel built-in factor described on the chain page.

Models certificate liability from a declared embedded total, a declared factor year, declared EUA prices and a declared origin carbon price, with a de minimis screen, a quarterly holding schedule, a purchase window and a surrender deadline. The 2026 vintage uses quarterly-average-of-quarter-of-importation pricing; weekly closing-average pricing applies from 2027 onward. Repurchase and cancellation are not modelled by this step.
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run execution hashes (final stage)

title: CBAM Precursor Certificate Liability Check
